name: Cute Felt Nurse Badge Reels (8 Pack)
seoTitle: Cute Felt Badge Reels for Pediatric Nurses
metaDescription: Eight cute felt badge reels that pediatric nurses love for putting kids at ease. A sweet holiday or stocking gift for anyone who wears an ID badge.
summary: Soft, cute felt badge reels that work especially well for pediatric nurses, giving young patients something friendly to look at during a scary visit.
whyItWorks: On a pediatric floor, a cute badge reel is more than an accessory. A child who is nervous about a blood draw or a new room will often fixate on whatever is dangling from the nurse's badge, and a soft felt character gives them something friendly to focus on. Pediatric nurses tend to keep a little collection for exactly that reason.

Felt has a softer, handmade look than the usual plastic reels, which fits the gentle tone of a children's unit. With eight in the set, the recipient can rotate designs, keep a seasonal one for the holidays, or share a few with coworkers. The title points to a holiday theme, so it makes a sweet Christmas gift or stocking stuffer for a nurse friend. It also works for a nursing student starting a pediatrics rotation, since it is a fun way to arrive on day one with a little confidence. Bundle it with a festive mug or a box of cookies for the break room.
goodToKnow: Check the listing photos to see which characters are included in the Lovely Style set.
Felt designs can pick up dirt, so check the listing for any care guidance before gifting.
Confirm the clip type on the listing if the recipient attaches their badge in a particular way.

faq.q: Are these only for pediatric nurses?
faq.a: They suit pediatric nurses best, but anyone who likes cute accessories will enjoy them. Adult unit nurses often use them as a cheerful seasonal swap.

faq.q: Are felt badge reels allowed at hospitals?
faq.a: Many hospitals allow decorative badge reels, but some units have infection control rules about fabric items. The recipient will know their own policy.
